feature_name: Preserve default_factory in tool call schema generation
description: Fix the issue where fields with default_factory in a tool's args_schema are incorrectly marked as required in the generated JSON schema. Currently, when creating subset models for tool calls, the default_factory attribute is dropped during field reconstruction, causing Pydantic to treat these fields as required. The solution should ensure both default and default_factory are properly forwarded when rebuilding FieldInfo objects.
functional_requirements: Modify the subset model creation logic to preserve the default_factory attribute alongside the default attribute when reconstructing fields
Ensure fields with default_factory are correctly marked as optional (not required) in the generated JSON schema for tool calls
Add test coverage to verify that tools with default_factory in their args_schema properly generate schemas where those fields are optional
